fact: At Agadez on 28-29 August 2026 Niger's territorial administration director general said the planned Registre National de la Population will be interoperable with the civil-status, biometric ID card, travel document and nationality registers, with a unique number attributed to each person for public and private services.
title: État civil et identification des personnes : Agadez accueille la quatrième étape de la tournée nationale de sensibilisation sur les réformes
